mapper.select: SELECT msg.id, msg.from_uid, msg.to_uid, msg.content, msg.status, msg.create_time FROM user_message msg, (SELECT from_uid , MAX(create_time) AS max_time FROM user_message GROUP BY from_uid) AS max_msg, WHERE msg.from_uid = max_msg.from_uid AND msg.create_time = max_msg.max_time AND DATEDIFF(NOW(),msg.`create_time`) <= #{innerDay} AND DATEDIFF(NOW(),msg.`create_time`) >= 0 AND msg.`to_uid` = #{userId} ORDER BY msg.`create_time` DESC
SELECT msg.* FROM user_message AS msg WHERE (msg.from_uid = #{userFirId} AND msg.to_uid = #{userSecId}) OR (msg.from_uid = #{userSecId} AND msg.to_uid = #{userFirId}) ORDER BY msg.create_time ASC

SELECT msg.id, msg.from_uid, f_u.avatar, f_u.nickname, msg.to_uid, t_u.avatar, t_u.nickname, msg.content, msg.status, msg.create_time FROM user_message msg, (SELECT from_uid , MAX(create_time) AS max_time FROM user_message GROUP BY from_uid) AS max_msg, user f_u, user t_u WHERE msg.from_uid = f_u.id AND msg.to_uid = t_u.id AND msg.is_deleted = 0 AND msg.from_uid = max_msg.from_uid AND msg.create_time = max_msg.max_time AND msg.`to_uid` = #{userId} ORDER BY msg.`create_time` DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE user_message AS msg SET msg.status = #{status} WHERE ( (msg.from_uid = #{userFirId} AND msg.to_uid = #{userSecId}) OR (msg.from_uid = #{userSecId} AND msg.to_uid = #{userFirId}) ) AND msg.status = 0
